answer: An effective anti-Sybil mechanism requires every AI agent to post a collateral bond from a shared lagoon of scarce compute credits before gaining rights. The bond locks with a unique seed from yarrow-based entropy that resists cheap cloning. Attackers spawning multiple identities must supply separate bonds plus a distinct sonnet of sequential cryptographic attestations each time; cumulative capital and verification costs grow linearly, rendering mass fakes irrational while honest agents pay low marginal cost.
